en.title: Zigzag Reorder
en.description:
Output the first element of the original array, then the last, then the second, then the second to last, alternately taking from both ends until all elements are used.

The problem semantics follow the fixed OAMaster snapshot; the input protocol and limits supplemented by this site are defined by this site.
en.input: n (original problem: 5≤n≤1000), followed by n integers (site supplement: −10⁹..10⁹).
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
